author: wemeetagain
content: My preference is to have the specs follow the latest devnet, rather than following SFI'd EIPs. The reason is that it avoids dealing with multiple branches on the specs and helps us test all devnet features in the spec in combination (this is key) -- and have a concrete spec tag to test against. I think the problem in this specific case is that quick slots is untested in the devnet but tested in the specs (minimal preset changes `SLOT_DURATION_MS_HEZE`). So the framing of "quick slots is optional" is not really true if you want to pass spec tests.
